basis: Sixteen complete development pairs; selected best result can be optimistic. Use variance .10, exceeding observed IID_WIDE variance, and include smaller-effect sensitivity. This is planning, not inference or a minimum Elo.
allocationJudgment: The strongest distinct information-acquisition policy merits an independent first stage (~46 minutes). At planning variance, 1024 pairs can resolve roughly +25 Elo with about 80% power; no rule requires that magnitude. Expensive later stages occur only if earlier complete looks neither decide nor reach forecast futility. An inconclusive result can motivate materially different SR007 mechanisms; these looks do not cap the feature or permit extending a closed confirmation.
